---
title: "PairLoom next & recommendation"
author: "Yun Jiang"
---

## next

1. M: extend candidate discovery to slide gapped (indel-bearing) alignments via bounded local realignment.
2. M: batch the joint-rescue reference search with a multi-pattern index (Aho-Corasick style, per work chunk) so genome-scale runs avoid the per-template linear scan.
3. M: add a `--merge-stats-parquet` optional output with overlap-length distributions and merge-rejection reason counts.
4. L: build a calibrated joint-MAPQ model for rescued pairs to replace the flat output MAPQ 0.
5. L: profile and optimize the per-template SAM-string serialization in the single-process path.
6. L: add a GitHub Actions workflow (pixi-based test matrix, ruff, benchmark smoke) with Dependabot.
7. L: promote the synthetic known-fragment benchmark into the repo suite under `benchmarks/`.

## recommendation

1. M: choose between fastp and PairLoom by required semantics — sequence recovery vs placement honesty — not by merge rate.
2. M: treat merge-reason summaries (now including `rescue_*` reasons) as pipeline telemetry in downstream QC reports.
3. M: for low-MAPQ-heavy cohorts on large references, measure joint-rescue cost on a sample first; `--no-rescue` opts out.
4. L: before relying on `--force-mapq60-exact`, quantify the repeat content of the target reference.
5. L: for very large cohorts, prefer `--threads 4` with `--chunk-size 256`.
